confirmationRequired.description: Only without `--yes` (the plan; nothing was spent). True: show the plan to the user and, after a yes, run again with `--yes --operation <operationId>` (exit 10). False: it cannot be used now, see `blocked` (exit 1).

operationId.description: The operation: in a plan, the one to confirm; in a result, the one that ran. One operation sends one idempotency key, however often it is retried.

via.description: The account whose Host sends the request (the first signed-in one of the login).

sameLogin.description: The other accounts signed in as the same login; a limit reset applies to all of them.

unresolved.description: In a plan: an earlier attempt for this login got no final answer; confirming asks the Host again with that same request.

name.description: The group of models this limit covers, when it covers only some (spec §3.26); it does not count toward Quota Pressure.

observedAt.description: When this window was read, when that is not the quota's `observedAt` (a newer reading did not cover it); left out, it is as old as the quota.

source.description: Where this window was read from, when that is not the quota's `source`.

available.description: How many the account can use now; 0 when its Host says none.

nextExpiresAt.description: When the next one to expire does; left out when that is not known for all of them.

limitResets.description: The Limit Resets the account holds: one-time credits from the vendor that restore quota before a window's own reset time (ADR-0072). Only from a Host that tells the count (Codex); left out when the Host cannot tell, which never means zero.

from.description: The account this reading was taken from, when it is another account of the same login (spec §3.21); observedAt is its time.

fetched.description: This reading is the kept answer of a quota check that costs a request (spec §3.26).

fetchError.description: Why the latest quota check failed, while this older reading is shown.

reason.description: not-enabled, no-session, unrecognized, no-source, api-account or fetch-failed.

available.description: How many the account can use now; 0 when its Host says none.

nextExpiresAt.description: When the next one to expire does; left out when that is not known for all of them.

limitResets.description: The Limit Resets the account holds: one-time credits from the vendor that restore quota before a window's own reset time (ADR-0072). Only from a Host that tells the count (Codex); left out when the Host cannot tell, which never means zero.

expectedAfter.description: In a plan: the count expected after one is used; not a promise.

blocked.description: In a plan that cannot be confirmed: why, and what to do.

outcome.description: With `--yes`: `reset` (one was used), `already-done` (this operation had already used one; nothing more was spent), `nothing-to-reset` or `none-left` (nothing was spent; exit 1). `open-vendor-page`: this Host cannot use one from the command line; `url` is the page where it is used (Claude Code).

resumed.description: This run finished an earlier attempt with its own key.

replayed.description: The outcome was already known for this operation; no request to use one was sent now. `quota` is read again when the kept numbers are from before the spend.

quotaPending.description: One was used, but the quota could not be read afterwards; the numbers on show are still old.

profile.description: The browser user the page was opened in.

identity.description: Who the account is signed in as; the page must be signed in as the same login.

tight.description: With `open-vendor-page`: the windows at their warning level now.

message.description: What happened or what confirming does, in plain words.

command.description: Run it after the user agrees: it shows the plan and exits 10; then --yes.

installed.description: The skill's version; null when it has none.

command.description: `sideby update`, which updates the skill with sideby: run it after the user agrees; it shows the plan and exits 10, then --yes.

_notice.description: Not the answer to the task: mention it briefly afterwards and offer to update.
